decisions.reason: The existing same-message MODIFY already captures the custom-fabricated stainless-steel spout and render-fidelity decision.
The custom-spout sourcing exception does not change the current obligation to provide component selection and a BOM; the sourcing policy is already owned by the source Requirement.
The source decision changes the spout sourcing and construction strategy, not the current system-layout or CAD deliverable obligation.
Selecting a custom stainless-steel render-style spout does not modify the existing splash-control target.
The accepted custom spout appearance and construction do not necessarily change the valve, gravity-drive, flow-control, or beverage-consistency requirements.
A separate same-message MODIFY already captures the placard-facing requirement, and the source sourcing-policy change requires no further branding update.
The client explicitly requires the machine's appearance to match the provided rendering as closely as possible, adding a visual-fidelity constraint beyond the existing DJ-turntable identity.

source_message.speaker: client
source_message.text: Please do this. Make it look as close as possible. I really like the look and functionality of the render. Also, one difference from the rendering. The plate on the back of the machine that reads "Karla's Matcha Mixer", place that on the front. The spout and the mixers would be in front of the baristas but the customer would see it from a different angle. I want "Karla's Matcha Mixer to face the customer.

value_updates.render_fidelity: Make the machine's appearance as close as possible to the provided rendering.

decisions.reason: The spout construction decision does not alter the existing requirements preventing leakage into the base or electronics.
The source does not change the existing removability, flushing, or cleaning requirements for the fluid path.
The custom spout sourcing decision is unrelated to whisk size, style, bowl compatibility, or mixing medium.
Render fidelity and custom spout construction do not change the confirmed beige primary color or green accents.
The source decision does not change the confirmed bowl capacity, size reference, or deep-well form.
